name: dsh-atomcode-bridge
description: Bridge the locally signed-in AtomCode (official binary, terminal AI coding assistant) into DeepSeek Harness as side tools: `atomcode_ask` (daemon side-conversation with session continuity, bounded by default) and `atomcode_review` (one-shot bounded code review via the CLI, with an explicit repository requirement). No API key, no model-provider takeover — the bridge is intentionally tools-only, and degrades loudly (never silently) when AtomCode's private protocol drifts.

scripts.test: node test/daemon-parse.test.mjs && node test/daemon-stream.test.mjs && node test/review.test.mjs && node test/review-select.test.mjs && node test/wiring.test.mjs && node test/client-id.test.mjs && node test/client-fns.test.mjs && node test/ask-glue.test.mjs && node test/stats-route.test.mjs && node test/quota.test.mjs && node test/protocol.test.mjs
